Solve one synthetic subject through linCmtA()/linCmtB() (test hook)

Source: R/RcppExports.R
dot-linCmtHostSim.Rd

Replays rxode2's linear-only solve loop on local stand-ins for its solver structs: each record advances the linear system from the previous record (the model's value call), stores the amounts (and with linCmtB() their sensitivities), then applies the record's dose. A second pass re-queries every record as rxode2's output pass does.

Usage

.linCmtHostSim(
  t,
  doseCmt,
  doseAmt,
  doseRate,
  theta,
  ncmt,
  oral0,
  trans,
  useB,
  sensType,
  ndiff,
  sensPhi,
  calls,
  linH,
  ss,
  ssTau,
  ssVar,
  ssCmt,
  lagMask,
  originMask,
  hPar,
  hStep,
  forwardMax
)

Arguments

t

record times (sorted)

doseCmt

linCmt state receiving the record's dose (0 = depot when oral, else central), or -1 for an observation

doseAmt

bolus amount (0 for none)

doseRate

infusion rate change at the record (0 for none)

theta

numeric matrix, one row of (p1, v1, p2, p3, p4, p5, ka) per record

ncmt

number of compartments

oral0

1 for a depot, else 0

trans

parameterization code

useB

TRUE for linCmtB() (sensitivities), FALSE for linCmtA()

sensType

linCmtB() Jacobian method

ndiff

linCmtB() derivative bit mask (0 = all)

sensPhi

linCmtSensPhi control (-1 unset, 0, 1, 2)

calls

integer matrix of extra (which1, which2) linCmtB() calls made after each record's value call in the output pass

linH

finite-difference steps (length 7) for the FD methods

ss

per-record steady-state type (0 none, 1 infinite infusion, 2 repeated infusion, 3 repeated bolus) evaluated at that record

ssTau, ssVar

steady-state interval and infusion duration or bolus amount per record

ssCmt

steady-state bolus compartment per record

lagMask, originMask

the model's op->linCmtLagMask and op->linCmtOriginMask

hPar, hStep

with hPar >= 0, an H-perturbed evaluation of parameter hPar by hStep (rxode2's step-size probe)

forwardMax

linCmtForwardMax: the most points the forward difference methods use (rxode2's default is 2)

Value

list with val (solve pass value per record), lhs (output pass value), state (solve buffer, one row per record) and calls (output pass results of calls, one row per record)
